Wayfarer-class Medium Transport 

The unusual design of the Wayforer-class medium transport allows cargo 
pods to be attached and detached from the port side of the vessel as needed. 
This modular design enables a Wayfarer to load a passenger section, hangar 
bay, or cargo module, depending on what is needed at the time. A Wayfarer 
features powerful engines that can handle the large mass of bulk freight 
and that give the vessel surprisingly good speed. However, its unusual 
layout makes the Wayfarer ungainly and difficult to pilot in anything less 
than ideal conditions. 

The 82-meter Wayfarer-class medium transport requires a crew of ten for 
optimal operation, but it can be flown effectively with only a pilot and one
